propositions: The complexity baseline file has no CI lock equivalent to the module-size limit lock, allowing any contributor to modify it without administrative override
The baseline can grow silently by adding new entries because the test only guards schema and count equality, not monotonic non-increase of entries
The baseline lock must semantically compare ceilings mappings and reject raised ceilings or added entries while allowing removed entries and lowered ceilings
When the base copy from main cannot be fetched, the lock must fail closed rather than emitting a warning and proceeding with unverified branch values
A new function above the C901 complexity threshold must fail CI even when a matching baseline entry is added in the same change
